text: You have a point: invasions alone do not explain why the West fell and the East did not. I added the debate next to the article.

block.title: Invasions or internal failure?
block.because: You disagreed that invasions were the main cause
block.md: Many historians agree invasions alone cannot explain the fall, since the East survived similar pressure [L]. [[Peter Heather|person]] still gives the Huns and the peoples they displaced a central role, while others stress civil wars, usurpations and fiscal strain inside the West [C].
